description: The runner's own control (`tools/runner-control.mjs`), played apart from the cases. `dead-entry.json` is refused by `register/dead-entry`, and the runner has to report nothing of it as written. It has to report each variant besides, every one a rule no prepared case can prove, since every case is built to fire its own: without `replaceFile`, a case that passed; with `check` set to `denominator`, a case that fired another check; with `rule` set to `entry-without-file`, a case that fired another rule.
